hack.root_cause: Signature verification bypass via deprecated sysvar → fraudulent SignatureSet → fake mint of 120k wETH on Solana
hack.description: Wormhole's Solana bridge was tricked into minting 120,000 wETH backed by nothing, by exploiting a subtle discrepancy in Solana's sysvar API that bypassed guardian signature verification.
